result_text:
I changed the `all_files.zip` packaging in `exportJson` so it looks up and names each entry the same way the loose files are written. The reports module compiles and its tests pass offline (`mvn -q -o -pl reports test` printed nothing, which means no failures).

**What changed:** in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java` (around lines 641–652), the five hardcoded `aspect_*.txt` literals are replaced by a loop over the five scope aspects. Each entry name comes from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same call `saveSourceCodeAspect` uses to write the loose file. The entries are added in the original order: main, test, generated, build and deployment, other.

With the default config the names are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. The `git-history.zip` logic is untouched.

I did not run the renamed-aspect scenario end to end; I checked it by reading the code path. I did not commit.
